messages:
Maya: Quick note — Sophie's birthday is Friday. Thinking desk streamer poppers (no glitter) + a small donut box at 3pm. Thoughts? :tada:
people-ops-bot: Budget tag `POPS-77`. React :donut: for donuts, :balloon: for balloon+plant. Poll open until Thu 5pm.
Owen: Donuts ✋ I can pick up 12 from the shop. Any GF reqs?
Sophie: (lol I'm on the thread) I prefer low-key, donuts sound great. I'll be in the office that day.
Diego: I'll bring a foil balloon and hide the gift in the tech closet. No latex pls.
Claire: I'll take photos and upload to #memes. Also can we use streamer poppers instead of confetti? Less messy.
Maya: Good call — streamer poppers only. Owen, can you do 2 GF donuts and label them?
Owen: Yep — 2 GF and 2 vegan marked.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled Fri 2:45pm "Set up Sophie's desk surprise".
Maya: Thanks all! Remote folks DM me for the e-gift card amount. :sparkles:
